# Passerelle (Full Context)

Passerelle is a secure tunneling tool that enables developers to expose local services globally without compromising their network.

## Commands

- `passerelle setup`: Register daemon and start under PM2.
- `passerelle link`: Show one-time link to validate machine.
- `passerelle status`: Show daemon status and tunnel URL.
- `passerelle ui`: Attach UI to running daemon.
- `passerelle version`: Show version and commit.
- `passerelle config`: Edit persistent config.
- `passerelle restart`: Restart daemon via PM2.
- `passerelle register`: Re-declare daemon presence directly to the Gateway.

## Interactive UI Keyboard Shortcuts

When running `passerelle ui`, you can use the following shortcuts:
- `[r]` Renew PIN
- `[s]` Copy Link
- `[c]` / `[l]` View Status & Services
- `[h]` Privacy Mode (hides PIN and QR code)
- `[k]` Kill Sessions (revokes all active web sessions)
- `[p]` Re-register
- `[d]` Detach

## Configuration

Settings live in `~/.config/passerelle/passerelle-config.json`.
You can configure a `command_allowlist` to restrict which local CLI commands the web dashboard is allowed to start on your machine:
`passerelle config command_allowlist "opencode,kilo,pm2"`

For full documentation, visit the website or refer to the CLI Reference.
